Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Integration stall — request for trial extension & credits

Hi Ben / David,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We started wiring the webhook + SDK on our staging cluster overnight and hit a repeatable 503 during tokenization that kills the end-to-end flow. Our infra team traced a few noisy errors (attached log snippet + a screenshot of the agent console).

Because of the failure we can't finish the demo pipeline or run our load tests. Our GA timeline is still Q2 but the engineering team needs more time to validate the connector across our flows. Is there any chance Redwood can provide a short trial extension and a sandbox credit top-up so our team can complete the integration without being rate-limited? Specifically asking for: 14-day extension to our trial window and a 400k token sandbox credit to run the test suite and smoke tests.

Appreciate any flexibility — this demo is critical for our upcoming board review.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Product
CraftLane

- integration-log-snippet.txt (text)
- screenshot-error-503.png (image)

Hi Elena — thanks for the log and the context, and sorry for the disruption. We want to keep your team moving.

Quick notes:
- I’ve looped David (our integrations lead) to confirm the root cause and patch ETA.
- From a commercial side I can request a 14-day extension + a 400k token sandbox bump as a one-time safety buffer while you finish the integration. That’s our usual remedy for issues caused during integration.

Before I commit the credits, two quick asks so I can get approval faster:
1) Can you confirm the earliest time your engineers can run the full test suite (so we understand consumption profile)?
2) Would you be open to a brief joint troubleshooting session (30 mins) tomorrow so our engineering team can watch a repro and avoid repeated cycles?

If David confirms this is a short fix (<=5 business days) I’ll escalate to Marissa for approval and get the credits issued.

Ben — dug into the attached log. Short summary for the thread (internal tech note):
- The 503s look like a mismatch between the SDK call pattern and our router when payloads exceed the default chunking threshold; essentially the client is sending a combined prompt+context that trips a path we recently hardened.
- I can push a targeted patch to the SDK-server shim that avoids the regression, but we need to run it against their staging flows and run ~2 days of soak tests — estimate 3-5 business days total including validation.

Recommendation: approve the 14-day extension but only provision a 400k token safety buffer (rather than 500k) — should be enough for their test matrix and avoids overcommitting credits. I’ll volunteer to join the troubleshooting session tomorrow at 10am PT if Elena can make it.

David Kim
Lead Solutions Engineer — Integrations
Redwood Inference
